verdict.rationale: Ashby's API and docs show broad, well-documented coverage (candidate/application CRUD, webhooks, pagination, sync tokens) suggesting many UI actions can be automated, but there's no first-party claim of full API/UI parity, and a detailed hands-on account describes core administrative actions (account upgrades, adding SAML) having no self-service path at all—UI or API—requiring an email to support. This concretely contradicts the idea that everything doable in the UI is also doable programmatically. missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, evidence that admin/config actions (SAML, billing) are API-accessible, and independent confirmation the API covers UI-only features.
